description: Open-source single-binary CLI. Exercises the library / CLI rules (Rust, rule 2), the rust toolchain, the public API surface with CLI conventions and versioning, and leaving out visual identity, data and deployment documents.
answers: The schema file is YAML. Releases as binaries on GitHub plus a Homebrew formula later. Semantic versioning; the CLI flags and the JSON output are the public contract. No configuration file beyond the schema. Anything else: decide later.
